phase.action: Bind manuscript roles to the typography system, remove decorative initial-letter treatment, normalize font stack, size, weight, leading and paragraph rhythm, then inspect computed styles before rendering.
holdWhen: an opening paragraph uses an enlarged first character
bold or font size carries meaning absent from prose
body type is below the minimum size
font fallback changes Korean glyph coverage or hierarchy
typography tokens are bypassed by page-local overrides

materialChangeSignals: font family or available font set changes
page size, language or target reading medium changes
body size, line length or column count changes
